Our Focus

Websites, at the centre of every brand.

A website is the first place your clients judge you. That is why it is our primary focus — and why we surround it with every brand service your business needs, from logo design to marketing material.

◈

A focused specialism

Websites are our primary discipline, so every site we deliver benefits from specialist design, speed and a refined finish.

✦

Designed to convert

Every layout is composed to build trust and guide visitors to act — enquiring, calling or messaging your business on WhatsApp.

∞

Supported by full branding

Logos, identity and marketing design complement your website so your entire brand presents with one confident, cohesive voice.

How It Works

A clear process, from order to delivery.

  1. Consultation & order — Tell us about your business and what you need through the order page or WhatsApp. We confirm the scope and the fixed price: R1,000 in South Africa or KES 5,000 in Kenya.
  2. Design & build — Our team designs and builds your website to your brief.
  3. Private review link — We send you a private link to your completed website on WhatsApp. This review link never has a domain.
  4. Approval — You review the website and confirm your approval.
  5. Once-off payment — There is no deposit. You pay for the website once-off, on a date agreed with you between the 26th and 30th. Hosting is billed monthly.
  6. Your domain — Approximately 72 hours after payment, your website receives its own domain, such as yourbusiness.co.za in South Africa or yourbusiness.co.ke in Kenya.

Careers · Now Hiring

Sales Executive

OmniBranding is appointing Sales Executives in South Africa and Kenya. You will bring businesses to OmniBranding and earn 50% commission on every website deal.

South AfricaR500

Per website deal — 50% of R1,000 — earned once your client has paid for their website.

KenyaKES 2,500

Per website deal — 50% of KES 5,000 — earned once your client has paid for their website.

Payment

Paid to your bank

Commission is paid directly into your own bank account.

The position

Role overview

  • Sales Executive, selling websites for OmniBranding.
  • Directly employed by OmniBranding — this is not an independent or freelance arrangement.
  • Open to applicants in South Africa and Kenya.
Who you sell to

Target market

  • Businesses of any size.
  • Your focus is clients who need a website. Once a client has a website, other needs follow — logos, business cards, flyers, banners, vehicle branding and more. A brilliant Sales Executive communicates these opportunities to the client.
What you do

Responsibilities

  • Find businesses that need a website.
  • Present OmniBranding to clients using the Sales Demos links — agents must use these links when communicating with clients — and Our Work, to show what we have done for other businesses.
  • Submit each client’s details and requirements through the Agent Portal.
  • Obtain the client’s signed payment declaration and approval, and submit it through the Agent Portal.
  • Follow up with your clients — it is your responsibility to see that they pay.
  • Upsell: not only websites, but every other service OmniBranding offers.
How you earn

Commission

  • You receive 50% of each deal — R500 in South Africa, KES 2,500 in Kenya.
  • You are paid only when your client has paid for their website.
  • Commission is paid directly into your bank account.
What we expect

Targets & hours

  • Minimum of 20 deals per month to maintain your contract.
  • No fixed working hours — work when it suits you, but you must meet the target to maintain your contract.
  • OmniBranding does not provide data or airtime.
Our side

What OmniBranding does

  • We design and build every website for the clients you find.
  • We send you a private review link on WhatsApp. This link never has a domain.
  • The client’s domain is issued approximately 72 hours after they have paid for their website.
Integrity

Accurate information

  • All information you submit must be accurate. Wrong information will result in immediate dismissal.

The process

  1. Apply — apply on this page and attach your CV in the WhatsApp chat.
  2. Review & approval — our team reviews every application and responds within 72 hours.
  3. Contract & marketing material — approved candidates are sent their contract and marketing material.
  4. Sign & return — you start working once the signed contract is returned.
  5. Find clients & submit orders — capture the client’s details and requirements in the Agent Portal, with the client’s agreement.
  6. We build — OmniBranding designs the website and sends you a private review link on WhatsApp. It never has a domain.
  7. Approval & declaration — the client approves the website and signs a declaration stating their once-off payment date, between the 26th and 30th. Submit it through the Agent Portal.
  8. Client pays — you earn — once the client has paid, you receive your 50% commission. Their domain is issued approximately 72 hours later.
